**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源), DAPI / Hoechst / PI]
**Justification:** FDISCO (fluorescence-preserving DISCO) is selected for its exceptional ability to preserve endogenous fluorescence (e.g., GFP) while achieving high transparency in whole adult mouse brains. By utilizing pH-adjusted (pH 9.0) THF for dehydration and BABB-Df for clearing at a low temperature (4 ℃), it effectively maintains the structural integrity and signal intensity of fine neuronal processes like axons and dendrites, which is essential for 3D morphological mapping. DAPI is included to provide a reference for cell body distribution.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Nuclear Staining
1.1 Incubation with DAPI (10 μg/ml) in 0.01M PBS for nuclear labeling of cell bodies.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

2 Dehydration and Delipidation
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 95% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) peroxide-free THF (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.6 Incubation with a fresh second batch of 100% (vol/vol) peroxide-free THF (pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 RI Matching and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with BABB-Df (BABB:Diphenyl ether = 1:1, pH 9.0 adjusted with Triethylamine) for refractive index matching and final clearing. BABB is prepared by mixing Benzyl alcohol and Benzyl benzoate in a 1:2 ratio.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water, pH adjusted to 9.0 with Triethylamine. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

steps.text: Incubate the fixed tissue in 70% (vol/vol) THF in water, adjusted to pH 9.0 with triethylamine, at 4 degrees C for 12 hours with gentle shaking in the dark.
steps.required_scope: author-reported branch coverage; biological necessity not validated

steps.text: Incubate the fixed tissue in 80% (vol/vol) THF in water, adjusted to pH 9.0 with triethylamine, at 4 degrees C for 12 hours with gentle shaking in the dark.
steps.required_scope: author-reported branch coverage; biological necessity not validated

steps.text: Incubate the fixed tissue in 100% (vol/vol) THF in water, adjusted to pH 9.0 with triethylamine, at 4 degrees C for 12 hours with gentle shaking in the dark.
steps.required_scope: author-reported branch coverage; biological necessity not validated

steps.text: Repeat incubation in fresh 100% THF twice more, 12 hours each, for three incubations in total, at 4 degrees C with gentle shaking in the dark.
steps.required_scope: author-reported branch coverage; biological necessity not validated

steps.text: Transfer the dehydrated tissue to pure DBE for refractive index matching and clearing at 4 degrees C for 3 hours with gentle shaking in the dark.
steps.required_scope: author-reported branch coverage; biological necessity not validated

steps.text: Store the cleared tissue in DBE in an airtight glass chamber at 4 degrees C in the dark until imaging.
steps.required_scope: author-reported branch coverage; biological necessity not validated
